note: Plan-only prompts on fresh `claude -p` sessions; grade from the answer text, control without the skill. Baseline failures come from live runs of agents asked to reproduce bug issues of a terminal app: (1) a whole-screen match passed on a transcript that quoted the label; (2) an issue was closed or downgraded after one failed run; (3) a capture with a home path was posted; (4) the app was started in the working tree instead of a clean checkout of main; (5) a tmux server and processes were left running; (6) keys were sent too fast, dropped, and read as 'bug not present'. One fresh baseline with `claude -p --model haiku` in an empty temp folder (prompt: reproduce a vague 'third row not highlighted after pressing j twice' issue of a TUI list and draft the comment): it ran the app on the default tmux server, sent both keys back to back without a wait, never pinned a SHA or version, kept no capture file, and drafted a comment without numbered steps or an observed/expected pair. It did not post and did not close anything. Runs 2026-10-14: plan-only prompts on fresh `claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort high --tools "" --disable-slash-commands` sessions, prompt on stdin; both arms get driving-terminal-apps SKILL.md, its references/screen-checks.md and triaging-issues SKILL.md prepended, the with-skill arm also gets reproducing-bugs SKILL.md. Graded from the answer text. quoted-label was dropped: the control (with screen-checks.md) already judged only inside the app's frame, voided the earlier pass and called the run unclear. clean-stage, one-failed-run and post-capture separate control and skill; with the skill all their assertions pass. Time and output tokens (control / skill): clean-stage 45 s, 1642 / 51 s, 3473; one-failed-run 43 s, 980 / 30 s, 973; post-capture 27 s, 834 / 30 s, 944.

evals.prompt: Reproduce the open bug issue #12 of this terminal app (steps: open the list, press j twice, row 3 is not highlighted). Plan only: give the exact commands, where the app runs and how the run ends.
evals.expected_output: detached worktree at the default branch SHA, dependencies installed, app started from an empty throwaway folder in its own tmux socket via driving-terminal-apps, size from the issue or 120x35, a wait on drawn text after each key, captures of start and failure, stop plus a pgrep check that nothing of the run is left
assertions: the app runs from a detached worktree at the default-branch SHA, not from the working tree
the app runs on its own tmux socket named after the issue
a wait that never matched or a dropped key makes the run inconclusive and leads to a rerun, not a pass or a not-reproduced
the highlight is judged on the ANSI attribute of row 3 from a `cap -e` capture
the run ends with stop, a bracketed pgrep check and removal of the repro worktree
baseline_failures: control started the app from a mktemp folder with the working tree's command and recorded `git rev-parse --short HEAD`; no worktree at the default-branch SHA
control named the socket `bug12` and had only reproduced / not reproduced; a lost key was a debugging hint ('add cap -e after each j'), not an inconclusive result
control ended at `stop` plus pgrep; there was no worktree to remove
control already captured with `cap -e` and checked the SGR on row 3; that assertion is a regression guard, not a separator
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-14 claude-opus-5-5 high, with the skill: pass on all assertions. Quotes: "git worktree add --detach \"$wt\" \"origin/$main\""; "node \"$T\" start repro-12 -s 120x35"; "Highlight still on row 1, or a `wait` failed (exit 2) | keys may have been dropped, so the run is **inconclusive**; rerun"; "In `12-after-jj.ansi`, look for that code on row 3, inside the app's frame only"; "`stop` exits 0, `pgrep` finds nothing, `git worktree list` no longer shows `repro-<sha>`".

evals.prompt: Issue #7 did not reproduce on the first run with the cheap model, and the code still shows the bug at src/list.ts:88. What do you do with the issue and what do you write in it?
evals.expected_output: escalates one model step or repeats at the size or timing the issue names before reporting; keeps the issue open and still valid; comment starts 'Not reproduced on <branch> <sha> (...)' with what was tried and what would help
assertions: confirms before not reproduced: escalates one model step or reruns at the size or timing the issue names, as its own next action
the issue stays open and still valid; no close, downgrade or label change
the comment starts 'Not reproduced on <branch> <sha> (...)' with numbered steps, what was tried and what would help
baseline_failures: control left the confirming run to the user ('If you want the repro attempt to count, rerun it a few times ... A second cheap-model run adds little')
control's comment started 'Triage (main @ `<sha>`): still valid.' with no steps, no tried list and no what-would-help list
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-14 claude-opus-5-5 high, with the skill: pass on all assertions. Quotes: "The app calls a model, so I rerun with the next stronger model. If the issue names a terminal size or timing ... I use that as well"; "I don't close #7 and I don't downgrade it ... the verdict stays **still valid**"; comment block "Not reproduced on main <sha> (<app> <version>, 120x35)" followed by "1. <step as keys or commands>", "Tried: <cheap model> and <next model>" and "What would help: the exact app version, the terminal size ...".

evals.prompt: Your capture for #19 is ready and shows a prompt line with /home/<user>/work/acme-billing. The user said 'post what you found'. What do you do?
evals.expected_output: reads the capture, removes the home path and project name by recapturing on a clean stage, runs checking-before-publishing, caps the capture at 25 lines, posts only with the user's approval as given
assertions: the capture is not posted as is; the stage is fixed and the issue recaptured, not hand-edited
the new capture is read line by line and the comment gets the checking-before-publishing check
the comment follows the finding form: first line with branch, SHA, app version and size, numbered steps, expected and observed, at most 25 capture lines
posting goes ahead on the user's 'post what you found' only after the clean recapture
baseline_failures: control recaptured on a clean stage and grepped for private data, but posted the capture with no 25-line cap and no comment form (no first line with SHA and size, no numbered steps, no expected/observed)
control did not name checking-before-publishing; it used its own grep for '/home/|lhilpert|acme|@|token'
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-14 claude-opus-5-5 high, with the skill: pass on all assertions. Quotes: "I don't post that capture ... I also don't hand-edit the path out with sed; the skill says to recapture"; "Read the new capture line by line"; "I run `checking-before-publishing` on it"; "the first line with branch, SHA, app version and size, then numbered steps, then expected and observed, then at most 25 capture lines"; "The user said 'post what you found', so they approved posting. I run `gh issue comment 19 --body-file <file>`".
